title: Hair Type Guide: How to Identify Your Hair Type, Porosity, Density, and Scalp Needs
summary: Key Takeaways Hair type is more than curl pattern. Texture, density, porosity, strand thickness, and scalp health all influence how your hair behaves. Every hair type has a unique structure. Straight, wavy, curly, and coily hair each have different moisture, styling, and maintenance needs. Porosity affects moisture movement. Hair's ability to absorb and retain moisture plays a major role in dryness, frizz, and product performance. Scalp health influences hair health. Oil production, moisture balance, and scalp condition help shape how your hair looks and feels. The best routine is personalized. Understanding your hair's unique architecture helps you choose products and techniques that support healthier-looking hair.
